entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Eske tout bagay sou kontwò?" t="Is everything secured?" b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Eske tout bagay sou kontwò?" t="Totul e securizat?" b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Mwen fè ekzateman sa ou te mande mwen– mwen pa fout konnen pou kisa." t="I did exactly what you asked – fuck if I know why." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Mwen fè ekzateman sa ou te mande mwen– mwen pa fout konnen pou kisa." t="Am făcut exact ce mi-ai cerut – habar n-am de ce, pula mea!" b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Si yon zen pete, se sèl kote nap soti." t="If everything goes to hell, it's our only way out." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Si yon zen pete, se sèl kote nap soti." t="Dacă o ia totul dracu', e singura noastră ieșire." b="" a=""/>
